faq.heading: Frequently asked
faq.sub: Common questions about translating Spanish into English.

items.q: Can it translate spoken Spanish in real time?
items.a: Tap the mic, let the person speak, and the English appears within a couple of seconds of them finishing. It is not a live subtitle feed, but it keeps pace with a normal back-and-forth conversation.

items.q: Does it handle Latin American as well as European Spanish?
items.a: Yes. The translation follows the whole sentence, so regional vocabulary from Mexico, Argentina, Colombia or Spain is read in context rather than looked up word by word.

items.q: Can I paste a Spanish message instead of speaking?
items.a: Yes — switch to the keyboard and paste a message, an email or a whole paragraph, and read the English underneath it.

items.q: Can I reply in English and have it sent in Spanish?
items.a: Yes. The same thread works both ways: your English is translated into Spanish and can be read aloud for the other person.
Each conversation is kept as a topic you can reopen, and you can delete any thread or clear the whole history whenever you like.
Yes, there is a free allowance you can use straight away without an account. Signing in with Google raises the monthly quota and syncs your history.
